module.label: E-Signature
module.description: Prepare, send and track document signing through an approved provider, with the full audit trail kept in the CRM.

page.title: E-Signature
page.subtitle: Draft, send and track signature requests, and administer the provider accounts behind them. Every action on this page is the server's answer.
page.loadFailed: The module could not be loaded.
page.loadFailedHint: Check that you hold the module read right and that an administrator has switched the module on.
page.notEnabled: E-Signature is switched off on this instance, so no signature request can be prepared or sent.
page.gateClosed: No signature request can be sent yet.

gateReasons.ready: An enabled provider connection exists, so an authorized operation will be carried out.
gateReasons.module_disabled: The module is switched off in the settings.
gateReasons.connections_disabled: Provider connection administration is switched off in the settings.
gateReasons.encryption_key_missing: ENCRYPTION_KEY is not configured, so a stored credential cannot be read and no connection can be used.
gateReasons.no_enabled_connection: No provider connection is authorized and active. An administrator has to connect a provider first.

page.adminNote: An administrator can switch the module and its features on under Settings, Integrations, E-Signature.

stats.gateHint: Settings, an active connection and the encryption key
stats.featuresHint: Switched on and implemented in this build

page.diagnosticsHint: Feature switches, the rights you hold, and what the bound adapters support.

features.title: Features
features.hint: A switch does something only once the module is on and the phase that implements the feature has shipped.
features.enabledHint: Switches the whole module on: the menu entry, the settings and every command.

settings.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.
settings.secretRefused: This field cannot hold a secret; provider credentials are stored only in the encrypted vault.
settings.integrationKeyEnvVars: An operator may keep this in the deployment environment instead: {names}.
settings.integrationKeysHint: These are OAuth client ids, which are public by nature. The matching client secret is never a settings field.
settings.resendCooldownMinutesHint: A second reminder for the same request is refused until this window passes. 0 disables the cooldown.
settings.embeddedReturnHosts: Hosts an embedded signing view may return to
settings.embeddedReturnHostsHint: An embedded signing link may only return to one of these hosts. No host means no embedded signing can be started.
settings.endpointUrl: Webhook endpoint to register with the provider
settings.requireHmac: Require a verified signature for every event
settings.requireHmacHint: Leave this on. Turning it off lets any caller change a contract state.
settings.webhookPayloadDays: Days the minimized event payload is kept
settings.completedArtifactDays: Days signed documents and completion evidence are kept
settings.completedArtifactDaysHint: A value of 0 means nothing is deleted automatically. Dropping the evidence of a signed contract needs a reviewed policy.
settings.approvalHint: Choose when a request needs a second person's decision before it can be sent.
settings.requiredForSourceEntities: Source record types that always need approval
settings.preventSelfApproval: Separate the reviewer from the preparer
settings.preventSelfApprovalHint: The person who created or prepared a request cannot approve it. Turn this off only if the installation genuinely has no second approver.
settings.approvalRulesHint: Each rule reads one field of the linked source record. An unreadable or empty field fails closed: the request still needs approval.

connections.title: Provider connections
connections.hint: A connection is the provider account documents are sent through. Credentials are write-only: this screen can store or replace them, never read them back.
connections.loadFailed: The provider connections could not be loaded.
connections.emptyHint: Create one with the credential its provider uses, then connect it. Nothing can be sent until a connection is authorized and active.
connections.providerHint: The e-signature provider this connection sends through. A provider whose integration is not installed in this build cannot be chosen yet.
connections.environmentHint: Demo and production are separate integrations, secrets and accounts. An existing connection is never switched between them.
connections.clientIdHint: Public by nature. Leave it empty to use the key configured in the module settings.
connections.redirectUriHint: Exactly the URI registered with this provider's application, and it has to point at this platform callback path.
connections.secretHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Nothing in this screen can read a secret back.
connections.secretWriteOnly: This writes to the encrypted vault. A stored credential is never returned by any read.
connections.disconnectConfirmHint: Its credentials are destroyed and provider calls stop. Requests, events, signed documents and audit rows are kept.
connections.disconnectedWithHistory: Disconnected; {credentials} credential(s) destroyed. Existing signature requests were kept.
connections.fakeAdapterNote: A {mode} adapter answered, so nothing reached a real provider.
connections.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted and verified against the provider before the connection is created. Nothing in this screen can read it back.

requests.title: Signature requests
requests.hint: Every request as the server sees it. Open one to review its documents, recipients and provider history.
requests.emptyHint: Create a draft, attach the documents, name the signers, then send it from the preview.
requests.loadFailed: The signature requests could not be loaded.
requests.saveFailed: The draft could not be saved.
requests.createHint: Save the draft first; documents are attached to the request that exists.
requests.sourceRecordHint: The record this request belongs to
requests.sourceMissing: The linked {entity} record no longer exists
requests.sourceRestricted: The linked {entity} record is outside your access
requests.embeddedOpened: A signing session was opened in a new tab.
requests.embeddedFailed: The signing session could not be started.
requests.documentAttached: The document was snapshotted onto the draft.
requests.documentFailed: The document could not be attached.
requests.downloadFailed: The document could not be downloaded.
requests.removeDocumentConfirm: Remove this document from the draft?

reports.title: Operational reports
reports.loadFailed: The operational reports could not be loaded.
reports.windowHint: Every figure is scoped to the requests you may read. The window applies to created (status, volume), sent (rates) and completed (time to completion); the current queues below ignore it.
reports.cohortHint: Denominator: {cohort} requests sent in the window.
reports.waitingHint: {requests} requests in flight; oldest envelope waiting {oldest}.
reports.completionHint: Based on {completed} completed requests with a recorded send and completion time.

operations.title: Operations and recovery
operations.loadFailed: The operations workbench could not be loaded.
operations.moduleOff: The E-Signature module is switched off. Diagnostics remain readable; no recovery action will run until an administrator turns it back on.
operations.noDeliveries: No delivery is waiting for an operator.
operations.noRequestAccess: You do not hold a request read right, so request ids are hidden. Connection and webhook diagnostics remain available.
operations.jobsHint: Job retry stays in the shared Jobs screen. No action here re-sends an envelope.
operations.retryFailed: The delivery could not be retried.
operations.reconciled: The request was reconciled with the provider.
operations.reconcileFailed: The request could not be reconciled.

templates.title: Template mappings
templates.hint: Map a provider template’s roles and fields to this CRM before a request can use it.
templates.selectConnectionHint: Choose the connection whose account holds the templates.
templates.refreshHint: Refresh the provider catalog to see the templates this account offers.
templates.refreshFailed: The template catalog could not be refreshed.
templates.detailFailed: The template could not be read from the provider.
templates.loadFailed: The template mappings could not be loaded.
templates.saveFailed: The template mapping could not be saved.
templates.noConnectionsHint: Connect and authorize a provider account before mapping its templates.
templates.noMappingsHint: Map a template to say which CRM recipients fill its roles and which CRM fields reach its tabs.
templates.templateInfoHint: The roles and tabs below come from the provider. Nothing here changes the template itself.
templates.problems: The mapping is not valid yet
templates.sourceEntitiesHint: The entities this mapping serves. Every field below must exist on each of them.
templates.sourceEntitiesRequired: Name at least one CRM source entity.

approval.title: Approval
approval.waitingAction: Review the digests and recipients, then approve or reject. The decision is recorded against this exact snapshot.

approval.versionHint: The decision applies to request version {version}. Any later edit invalidates it.
approval.failed: The approval decision could not be recorded.
approval.approvedNotice: Approved for version {version}; sending is now available.
approval.rejectedNotice: This request was rejected and cannot be sent as it stands.
